title: "See, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands."
paragraphs:
"See, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands."
— Isaiah 49:16

Maybe people overlooked you.
Maybe you feel invisible.
Maybe it seems like your prayers disappeared into silence.

You are not overlooked.
You are not forgotten.
Your name is written where He will never lose it.

Identity Truth:
You are remembered by your Father.
